2609.10445.title: Building Multilingual Bridges: Data Mixing as the Pillar of Generalization for In-Language Reasoning
2609.10445.paper_summary: Reasoning language models have made substantial advances on a variety of complex tasks, yet their capabilities remain overwhelmingly English-centric: models primarily reason in English regardless of the language they are prompted in. This is inaccessible for non-English-speaking users, risks losing the intent of the original question, and forgoes knowledge more readily expressed in the target language. In this work, we advance L2 reasoning, the ability of a model to reason consistently in the language of the user's prompt, thus building an in-language bridge between the prompt and the answer. We approach this problem from a data-centric angle, investigating how to optimize data composition and scheduling in SFT for reasoning generalization. Building Tiny Aya L2-Thinker at 3.35B scale, we achieve an L2 reasoning rate above 93% across 60 languages on 6 benchmarks spanning math, commonsense reasoning, instruction following, open-ended generation, and cultural reasoning while keeping performance strong. We show the path to generalizing L2 reasoning to held-out languages goes through broader language coverage, readily available multilingual non-reasoning data, and a sufficient English reasoning backbone. These findings indicate that reasoning is a language-agnostic behavior that can be transferred across typologically diverse languages through careful data mixing and without requiring reasoning supervision in every target language. We release our model weights and multilingual reasoning data to support further research on accessible, in-language reasoning.
2609.10445.paper_summary_zh: 推理語言模型在各種複雜任務上取得了重大進展，但它們的能力仍然以英語為中心：模型主要在英語中進行推理，無論它們是以何種語言提示的。這對於非英語使用者來說是無法接觸的，並且有失去原始問題意圖的風險，同時放棄了更容易用目標語言表達的知識。在這項工作中，我們推進了L2推理，即模型在用戶提示的語言中一致推理的能力，從而在提示和答案之間建立了一座語言內的橋樑。我們從數據中心的角度來解決這個問題，研究如何優化數據組合和SFT中的調度，以實現推理的泛化。構建3.35B規模的Tiny Aya L2-Thinker，我們在數學、常識推理、指令遵循、開放式生成和文化推理的6個基準上，在60種語言中達到了超過93%的L2推理率，同時保持強勁的性能。我們顯示，將L2推理泛化到保留語言的途徑是通過更廣泛的語言覆蓋、隨手可得的多語言非推理數據以及足夠的英語推理基礎。這些發現表明，推理是一種語言無關的行為，可以通過仔細的數據混合在類型學上多樣的語言之間轉移，而不需要在每種目標語言中進行推理監督。我們釋放了我們的模型權重和多語言推理數據，以支持進一步研究可接觸的、語言內的推理。
